language_task: Stack the orange blokc on top of the green triangle.
outcome_evidence: Frames 65–78 in wrist_cam and right_base_cam show the orange block acquired and lifted toward the green triangular piece. Frames 116–125 show the fingers opening and withdrawing, leaving the orange block supported on the green piece; the stack remains stable in right_base_cam and wrist_cam through frames 140–240. The robot subsequently approaches the other orange-colored block, but the episode ends during finger closure without an established additional acquisition, displacement, or harmful side effect.
